column1: # Shared C/Swift evaluation-route vectors. Single source of truth.
# Add a case here and both harnesses must agree. Do NOT fork per-side cases.
# Columns (tab-separated, no trimming — whitespace is significant):
#   - "NULL" service = absent (C NULL / Swift nil). Client is never NULL.
#   - Empty field = empty string (distinct from NULL).
# Sign-prefixed and Int64-range majors: Swift Int("+1")/Int("-0") parse and
# Int holds 10-18 digit heads, while C rejects non-digit heads and caps at
# INT_MAX. Equal pairs must miss on both sides; INT_MAX itself still routes.
